## BLASTOMYCES DERMATITIDIS
Contact Infectious Diseases in all cases. Lifelong suppressive therapy may be
required in immunosuppressed patients if immunosuppression cannot be reversed.
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Disease outside of the central nervous system
## Inpatient

## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Treat for 6-12 months. It is recommended that immunocompromised patients be
treated with at least 1-2 weeks of intravenous treatment and a total treatment
duration of 12 months.
## Treatment for mild to moderate disease
[Itraconazole 200 mg PO q8h for 3 days then q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-itraconazole-200-po-tidx3days-then-200-bid)
## Treatment for severe disease
Change to oral itraconazole after the patient's condition has stabilized.
## Oral therapy after disease has stabilized
[Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-itraconazole-200mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Fluconazole 400-800 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-fluconazole-400mg-po-q24h)
